pr_title: [BugFix][MRV2]Fix synchronous H2D in UvaBufferWrapper fallback path
source_quote: 这里最好加个保护，如果_modified_indices不是连续值，fallback回原来的写法。

rule.description: 当性能优化依赖于对数据布局的隐含假设（如连续性、有序性）时，必须添加显式检查并在假设不满足时回退到安全路径。
checkpoints: 识别优化路径是否依赖隐含假设（如索引连续、数据有序、shape 固定）
添加显式条件检查验证假设
提供安全 fallback 路径处理非预期情况

antipattern.code:
class UvaBufferWrapper:
    """Wrapper for UVA buffer with async H2D copy."""

    def __init__(self, uva_tensor, cpu_tensor):
        self._uva = uva_tensor
        self._cpu = cpu_tensor
        self._modified_indices: list[int] = []

    def flush(self):
        """Flush modified CPU rows to NPU via async copy."""
        if not self._modified_indices:
            return
        # ❌ 隐含假设：_modified_indices 总是 [0..n-1]
        # 若出现非连续修改，[:n] 会复制错误的数据
        n = len(self._modified_indices)
        self._uva[:n].copy_(self._cpu[:n], non_blocking=True)
        self._modified_indices.clear()
antipattern.context: ❌ 隐含假设：_modified_indices 总是 [0..n-1] 若出现非连续修改，[:n] 会复制错误的数据

pattern.context: ✅ 显式检查连续性，不满足时 fallback 到 indexed copy Common path: dirty rows are a contiguous prefix [0..n-1]. Sparse modification pattern — fall back to indexed copy.

diff.unified:
--- a/vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_uva.py
+++ b/vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_uva.py
@@ -10,8 +10,18 @@
         """Flush modified CPU rows to NPU via async copy."""
         if not self._modified_indices:
             return
-        # ❌ 隐含假设：_modified_indices 总是 [0..n-1]
-        # 若出现非连续修改，[:n] 会复制错误的数据
-        n = len(self._modified_indices)
-        self._uva[:n].copy_(self._cpu[:n], non_blocking=True)
+        # ✅ 显式检查连续性，不满足时 fallback 到 indexed copy
+        dirty_rows = sorted(self._modified_indices)
+        n_dirty = len(dirty_rows)
+        if dirty_rows[0] == 0 and dirty_rows[-1] == n_dirty - 1:
+            # Common path: dirty rows are a contiguous prefix [0..n-1].
+            self._uva[:n_dirty].copy_(
+                self._cpu[:n_dirty], non_blocking=True
+            )
+        else:
+            # Sparse modification pattern — fall back to indexed copy.
+            src = self._cpu[dirty_rows].pin_memory()
+            self._uva[dirty_rows] = src.to(
+                device="npu", non_blocking=True
+            )
         self._modified_indices.clear()
